content: If the parent action, matter action, readouts, measure/coframe, and boundary term descend through a quotient pi, and q lies only in the removed vertical/first-class directions, then the reduced physical Hessian has no q row/column and physical Green functions contain no q pole.

clause: q/quotient map is parent-defined before variation
content: q(Phi) or pi: Y -> Y_red must be a real parent object with units/domain, not a post-hoc residual label.

clause: actual vertical generator and degree count
content: The local q direction must be generated by a first-class/vertical vector in ker(Dpi), with symplectic bracket closure and removed canonical pair count.
needed_to_close: Omega, generator, bracket, and degree-count package

clause: action, matter, and observables factor through the quotient
content: S=Sbar∘pi, S_matter=Sbar_matter∘pi, and observable maps O=Obar∘pi must all use the same branch.
Removed q directions must not leave boundary charges, source tails, or local projection/readout remnants.
All no-pole clauses must pass together before D_qWeyl2 and q Green rows can be deleted rather than bounded.
